findings.problem: Adding -ar to imagine gives the misspelling imaginear, and a learner could memorize that; the e has to be dropped first.
findings.fix: trick: IMAGINAR is just imagine with the final e swapped for -ar: imagin-AR, to imagine.

note: The example uses the pronominal form me imagino, which is the most natural everyday way to say I imagine or I suppose in Latin America, so it is fine for this card.
